question.text: Under Regulation 3(5), the structured digital database of UPSI shall include which unique identifier?

answer.text: Permanent Account Number (PAN) or any other identifier authorized by law

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Regulation 3(5), the structured digital database must include the nature of UPSI, the names of persons sharing and receiving the information, and the PAN, or any other identifier authorized by law where PAN is not available. The Trap: Aadhaar alone, employee ID, or passport number alone is not the identifier specified by this regulation. Note: Per NISM-III-C (Securities Intermediaries Compliance - Fund) workbook (p.119). The database is maintained internally with appropriate time stamping and audit trails and is not to be outsourced.
